records.title: Excellence Master Fellowships (Faculty of Science, University of Geneva)
records.deadline_display: Next application deadline is 28 February, 2026 (for Masters starting September 14, 2026).
records.application_period: The application is made online, from the beginning of January of each year; after registering you receive an e-mail with a personal link to the application form. Deadline 28 February.

records.title: LiU International Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Official wording: "The application for LiU Scholarships opens each year on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results, and is only open for a short window. In 2026, the application period is as follows: 26 March - Application period opens. 30 March - Application period will close at 23:59 CET. 10 April - Scholarship recipients will be published on this page." The published dates are for the 2026 cycle; the next cycle's dates are not yet announced.
records.application_period: Opens on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results (usually end of March) and stays open only a few days; 26-30 March 2026 for the 2026 round, closing 23:59 CET on 30 March

records.title: Doctoral Recruitment Call 2026 - Social Sciences, Humanities & Cultural Studies (SSH Call 2026), University of Vienna
records.deadline_display: "Application period: 7 January – 2 March 2026, 14:00 CET" for the 2026 round; the University runs an annual central call and had not published the next window on 2026-10-04.
records.application_period: The 2026 round ran 7 January to 2 March 2026 at 14:00 CET. The University of Vienna announces a new central doctoral call each year, so the next application window must be confirmed on the careers site.

records.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - Tsinghua University Program (Type B)
records.deadline_display: Applicants are highly recommended to apply before Mid-December, 2025; the exact date is set by each school or department of Tsinghua University, so there is no single university-wide deadline.
records.application_period: The 2026 cycle page was published in November 2025 with pre-admission applications recommended before mid-December 2025. Tsinghua's 2027 international graduate admission round was announced on 5 September 2026, so the 2027 CGS Type B cycle is expected to open in the same period as the 2026 one.

records.title: ACU Stipend Scholarship
records.deadline_display: 1 April 2027 (next round); rounds close 1 April and 1 October each year
records.application_period: Applications open twice per annum, in April and in October. Round 1 closed 1 April 2026 and Round 2 closed 1 October 2026, so the next window is the April 2027 round. Domestic commencements are the first workday of the following August, international commencements the first day of Research Term D in October for the April round and Research Term C in July for the October round.
